description: Extract named entities from one block of text using Cloudflare Workers AI. Input is text, with an optional types filter such as person, organization, location or date. The answer returns a JSON array of name and type pairs, carries the model name, and is flagged machine_generated rather than verified. Recall varies and rare or domain-specific names can be missed. Use it for quick triage of documents, emails and articles. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
name: entities
